flows.name: Someone builds an app by telling Replit Agent what they want
flows.summary: Replit's page: "like having an engineering team on demand, with no coding experience required". Almost every step is the agent's; the person's part is to describe and to give feedback.

steps.what: Tells Replit Agent the app, website or agent they want to build.
Builds it, searching the web as needed for the latest information; for complex requests the person can turn on Extended Thinking and high-power models.
Connects the built-in database and user authentication, or third-party services such as Stripe and OpenAI, keeping the keys secure.
steps.agent: Wires up the services the app needs.

steps.what: Periodically tests the app in a browser while building, writes a report and fixes the issues it finds, in a reflection loop.
steps.agent: Tests and fixes its own code.

steps.what: Keeps improving the app by giving the agent feedback.
Can also build other agents and workflows, which the person can connect to apps such as Slack or email.
steps.agent: Builds agents and automations from natural language.
